findings: SettingsDialog explicitly shows no settings for Pinterest/Pixiv. Existing video-only preview preferences provide immediate independent local storage with commit-first failure handling.
Both image card grids use180px target minimum; Pixiv old small viewport rule forces140px. Readers already have separate fit/resize controls; this request concerns browsing card previews.

Pinterest public profile is a specific account, not personalized home; official search browser has no initial-home entry. Current3:4 image grid is not masonry. Pixiv is explicitly public no-cookie safe-mode reader, so adding only a login popup would not connect authenticated search/download. These findings are reported without changing those behaviors.
decision: Add isolated image preview preference helper for pinterest and pixiv, keys atsumi.<source>.preview-width.v1,180px default and140/180/220/280/340px steps. Do not alter video keys, defaults or subscribers.

Each existing platform settings tab has a compact range+pixel output matching video settings; immediately save first, dispatch only after success, retain last saved value and offer retry on failure. Exact provider key and bounded enum only.

PlatformWorkspace passes image width to the same mounted image provider; no key/remount/fetch changes. Each provider validates prop and sets a source-local CSS custom property; grid minmax(min(width,100%),1fr) prevents overflow and adjusts columns with available width. Explicit size stays respected on narrow windows instead of silently forcing140px.

Apply to native Explore/Favorites/Downloads card lists and inherited Pinterest removed-list grid, not official embedded website CSS or full-size page reader. Existing ratio/crop, controls, selection order, download behavior and privacy untouched. Do not silently implement masonry based on a question.
Prefer existing scopes and narrow helpers over new backend/DB/schema. No network required for size changes. No UI or file deletion, accounts, native build, or publication.
